novelty.justification: The claim proposes that subliminal learning has a "bounded, measurable channel capacity" and specifically predicts that capacity depends on "steering-vector orthogonality" rather than "human-semantic distinctness," making its novelty route a new multi-trait phenomenon and geometric mechanism within an established setting. Searches using "subliminal learning multiple traits capacity," "multi-trait subliminal transmission interference," "steering vector orthogonality multi-attribute interference," and "hidden channel behavioral trait capacity" identify Cloud et al., "Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data" (2025), as the closest setting-specific work, while "Beyond Linear Steering: Unified Multi-Attribute Control for Language Models" (2025) already studies interference when composing multiple behavioral attributes and "Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact" (2026) studies rank-dependent transmission limits. Moving from these works to measuring multi-trait subliminal capacity, relating interference to vector geometry rather than semantic similarity, and considering disjoint-layer packing is a substantive natural extension and multi-step integration, but not a wholly new core paradigm because channel capacity and vector-interference questions follow predictably from combining single-trait subliminal learning with established multi-attribute steering research.
